card_config.value: Add this card to your hand, or if you have the required energy, perform Raid with it.

card_set: Booster Pack Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Vol.2 [UEX05BT]
card_text:
【Raid】 <Tanjiro Kamado> Switch to active. May move to the front line.
[When Played] Look at the top five cards of your deck. Reveal up to one <Zenitsu Agatsuma> and up to one <Inosuke Hashibira> card among them and add them to your hand. Place the remaining cards on the bottom of your deck in any order. If you added two cards to your hand with this ability, place one card from your hand into your sideline.
[Activate: Main] #If on the Front Line# #Switch to Resting# Choose up to one <Zenitsu Agatsuma> and up to one <Inosuke Hashibira> on your field. They gain 2000 BP until the end of the turn.

regulations.title: One Battle Rule Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba
